"""Partition-aware regression baseline for predict-forward tasks with Decision Tree ensemble.

The dataset stores one file per entity and the scored rows are a contiguous
suffix of each test partition, so this script:

  * concatenates every train partition,
  * drops columns that do not exist at inference time,
  * anchors on the last observed target instead of predicting an absolute
    level, and
  * validates by holding out each training partition's tail, reproducing the
    same gap the leaderboard measures.

Ensemble: LightGBM + DecisionTreeRegressor (averaged residuals).
"""
